summary: Standards (atip.readwrites.04): the preview sweep counts a preview as proved when it succeeds (previewed >= 10) but compares the snapshot for every call, refused or not; it lists 12 previews in a loop plus ingest sessions and init separately, so all 14 dry-run commands are covered, but a --dry-run that was refused for a missing argument, as the checker's fixture would, writes nothing by the same assertion without proving the preview path. The refusal part (01, 07) is strong: it is the stale-index world with a snapshot of repo, HOME and TMPDIR, and 07 makes the store unwritable for a call that would otherwise refresh. Blast radius: spec 12.2 lists --dry-run, --help, --version, schema and skills show; the sweep covers every leaf's --help and schema and five guides, not every guide name.
